BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC announced on April 10, 2026, that it purchased 547,996 of its own ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc. The purchases were made under the share buyback program announced on March 2, 2026, with the highest price paid per share being 847.4000 pence and the lowest at 813.0000 pence, resulting in a volume-weighted average price of 821.3000 pence per share. All purchased shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 10 April 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 ⁴/₇₇ pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc ("Morgan Stanley"). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
